body: Starting today, eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim up to $500 per month in API credits to build apps and agents. Credit amounts depend on the plan. Pro plans get $100, $200 or $500 per month by tier. Business plans get $20 per paid Standard seat or $100 per paid Premium seat, pooled up to $500 per workspace. https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001626-api-credits-benefit-for-eligible-chatgpt-subscriptions
